description: Flavour graph for Voltage. Called by script_venue_regular via the trigger's voice param.

f0.text: The bouncer says your name into a collar mic. Nothing happens. Something did.

f1.text: Your drink is on the rail before you have finished crossing the floor toward it.

f2.text: Somebody points you out to somebody newer. You have become part of the tour.

r0.text: The bartender points at you across the floor, then at a bottle, eyebrows up. That is the whole conversation and it works.

r1.text: Someone shouts a greeting you cannot hear and you both nod as though you could.

r2.text: A gap opens at the rail that was not there a second ago, and closes behind you.

s0.text: The floor takes you in the way a crowd takes in weather. Briefly, and without follow-up.

s1.text: A bouncer maps you in one pass and files you under nothing in particular.

s2.text: The bass rearranges your ribs a little. Nobody offers an apology or a drink.

name: Venue voice — Voltage
